# API conventions

- Wrap with `withAuth(withErrorHandler(handler as any))` from `@/lib/auth`.
- Compose `withRole(...)` inside `withAuth` for role gates; use `withUserAuth` for JWT-only routes.
- Legacy `withCompany` is removed — do NOT use it.
- Response helpers: `apiResponse.success / badRequest / notFound / methodNotAllowed` from `@/lib/apiResponse`.
- Every query MUST scope by `company_id` and use `sql` tagged template from `@/lib/neon`.
- No `console.log` — use `log` from `@/lib/logger`.
